1	# Task 12: Marble and gold trophy on a pedestal
2	
3	Framework: Aura3D (`@aura3d/engine`, already installed in node_modules).
4	
5	Build a single-page browser app with the provided framework, served by vite, drawing into the existing canvas with id #app. Show an awards-ceremony trophy displayed on a stepped pedestal inside a dark, warm gallery space. The pedestal is white Carrara-style marble with grey veining, generated procedurally in code, for example with layered noise or turbulence-warped stripes, and with a polished, slightly glossy finish that faintly reflects the room. The trophy stands on top and is made of polished gold: a cup on a stem with two handles, built from lathe, revolved profiles or smooth curves, with a small engraved-looking band or ring in a darker, rougher gold, and a smaller base of black polished stone or dark wood with a thin gold plate. Gold must look like real gold: warm yellow, fully metallic, low roughness, with strong, slightly tinted environment reflections, not flat yellow. Light with one warm spotlight from above and in front that casts a soft pool of light and a visible falloff on the marble and a soft shadow behind the pedestal, plus a faint cool fill and a subtle rim light. Add a procedurally generated environment (a dark room with a few bright windows or lamps) so the gold has something to reflect. The camera makes a slow orbit of about 15 degrees each way around the trophy, keeping it centred and in frame. Expose window.__TASK_STATE__

4	
5	## Rules
6	- `createAuraApp` owns renderer, resize and loop: write none. Per frame `app.onFrame((f) => ...)` (`f.dt` seconds); end with `await app.ready()`; set window flags after it (`declare global { interface Window { __FLAG__?: boolean } }`).
7	- Vectors `[x, y, z]`, colours CSS strings. Primitives are unit shapes scaled by `size` (`sphere` size = diameter, `plane` `[w, 1, d]` lies in XZ): `primitives.box|sphere|plane|cylinder|capsule|cone|torus`. Node chain: `.position(x, y, z)`, `.scale([x, y, z])`, `.rotate(x, y, z)`.
8	- Animate later: `.runtime({ id, mutable: true })` then `app.nodes.require(id).setPosition(x, y, z)` / `.setRotation(x, y, z)`; light `.setLight?.({ intensity, color })`; shader `.setUniform?.(name, v)`.
9	- Instance `colors` multiply the material colour: use base `#ffffff`. Dark frame: add `environments.neutral({ intensity: 0.5, background: false })` or a hemisphere light.
10	- Camera `camera.orbit({ ..., autoRotate: radPerSec })` orbits its target slowly; never `app.camera`.

3	description: Chooses and verifies surface looks and lighting environments: built-in `material.*`, `environments.*`, `sky.dayNight`, `weather`, and `water` first, then licensed local textures or HDRIs admitted with `assets add --type texture`, with seam, PBR-channel, and visual-QA checks. Use when a route needs a material, texture set, PBR maps, HDRI or IBL, skybox, night or daytime sky, rain, snow, water, or KTX2 textures.

6	# Aura3D materials and environments
7	
8	Order is fixed: looks/biomes/env presets first, then built-ins, then a
9	licensed local file, then a generated plate as a candidate. There is no
10	catalog search for textures or HDRIs today (the asset index has no texture or
11	HDRI adapter), so `assets search` will not find them. Shared rules (claim
12	labels, typed assets, catalog-first for models, benchmark mode) are in
13	[../aura3d-core/references/boundaries.md](../aura3d-core/references/boundaries.md).
